name: Definely
description: Definely's MCP server gives AI assistants live, deterministic access to contract structure. Resolve definitions, validate cross‑references, map dependencies, and run structural diffs to see how edits propagate across an agreement. Use it to catch broken links and inconsistencies, explain impacts clearly, and ground legal reasoning in contract topology, not just text.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Definely to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Definely to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.app.definely.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Definely MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Definely lists 20 MCP tools, including get_document_table_of_contents, get_list_of_undefined_terms, get_list_of_defined_terms, get_containing_section, get_items_in_this_section, find_where_this_section_is_referenced, find_cross_references_in_this_section, find_undefined_terms_in_this_text, fetch_text_by_item_name, get_text_of_this_item, find_precedent_in_vault, and find_similar_precedent_in_vault.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Definely?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Definely in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Definely requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Definely is developed by Definely. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
